assets.caption: V-53 VENT — Engineering drawing of V-53 Vent assembly for NPS 2 & UP welded piping. Shows a sockolet connection on NPS 2 LINE SIZE & UP main pipe with a vertical vent branch consisting of NPS 3/4 SOCKOLET, NPS 3/4 x 100(4) NIPPLE (PLAIN BOTH ENDS), NPS 3/4 SOCKET WELD FLANGE, and NPS 3/4 BLIND FLANGE at top.

D-53 DRAIN — Engineering drawing of D-53 Drain assembly for NPS 2 & UP welded piping. Shows a sockolet connection on NPS 2 LINE SIZE & UP main pipe with a downward drain branch consisting of NPS 3/4 SOCKOLET, NPS 3/4 x 100(4) NIPPLE (PLAIN BOTH ENDS), NPS 3/4 SOCKET WELD FLANGE, and NPS 3/4 BLIND FLANGE at bottom.
